<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex01062025-05-1313-20-46" status="finalized">gzhan yang bsgrub bya tshan gsum bsrung pas sdom pa gsum ldan gyi tha snyad du mdzad pa yang mi rigs ste | 
       <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">dge bshes rgya</rs><!--We understand the note to specify a distinction in the system of the author of the work-->'i lugs la bzhi las 
         dang po gzhan gyi lugs gi spyad pa ni</note>
        dge slong mas rgyal po'i chang <pb edRef="inst:4477" n="23a"/><lb edRef="inst:4477" n="23a1"/> ba bcad pa'i mi nges par 'tsho' bar 'gyur ba sdug bsngal drag po can 'gyur byed kyi lan tsha brlud pas myur du gsod pa ni snying rjes ma bzod pa'i spyod pa yin kyang pham pa byung pa mod nas bshad pa'i phyir dge' slong lasogs pas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa <note type="gloss">°</note> ni snying rje chen pos kyang de lta bu bkag la | byang chub sems dpa ni bsgrub pa yin pa'i phyir <note type="gloss">slab bya</note> 'gal ba kho na'o |</seg></TEI>
